title: npm dependencies (node_modules)
description: The project's installed JavaScript packages.
regeneration: npm install (or yarn/pnpm/bun install) in the project folder.

title: Python environments (.venv)
description: A Python virtual environment with the project's installed packages.
regeneration: uv sync, poetry install or pip install -r requirements.txt.

title: .NET build output (bin, obj)
description: Compiled libraries and intermediate files of .NET projects.
regeneration: dotnet build or a build in Rider.

title: Swift Package Manager build (.build)
description: Downloaded dependencies and build output of a Swift package.

title: DerivedData in projects
description: Xcode build output stored in the project folder.

title: Build folders
description: Build output (Flutter, Gradle, CMake, Python). A folder counts only when it holds files a build tool generates and no source code.

title: Dart tool cache (.dart_tool)
description: Package configuration and Dart/Flutter tool cache of the project.

title: Gradle cache in projects
description: Local Gradle and Kotlin cache of the project.

title: CocoaPods dependencies (Pods)
description: Installed pods of an iOS project.

title: Frontend builds and web tool caches
description: Build output and caches of JavaScript tools (Vite, Next.js, Nuxt, Turbo, Angular) and test coverage reports.

title: Rust build artifacts (target)
description: Build output and intermediate files of a Cargo project (debug and release profiles).

title: Python tool caches
description: Compiled bytecode (.pyc) and caches of pytest, mypy, ruff and tox.

title: Claude Code agent worktrees
description: Working copies of a repository (git worktree) created by Claude Code agents. They may contain uncommitted work, so check the Git status shown for the item. After removing the folder, run git worktree prune in the repository.

title: Maven build output
description: Compiled files of a Maven project.

title: Playwright test results and reports
description: Results of Playwright test runs: traces, screenshots, videos and HTML reports, found next to a Playwright configuration. They can be the only record of an earlier failure.
regeneration: Run the tests again; the results of earlier runs cannot be recreated.

title: Cypress screenshots, videos and downloads
description: Screenshots, videos and downloaded files from Cypress test runs, found in the cypress folder of a project with a Cypress configuration. Tests, fixtures and support files are not included.
regeneration: Run the tests again; the results of earlier runs cannot be recreated.

title: Nox environments (.nox)
description: Virtual environments that Nox creates for each test session.
regeneration: nox creates them again on the next run.

title: Nx task cache (.nx/cache)
description: Saved outputs of Nx tasks in a workspace, used to skip work that was already done. The rest of the .nx folder (workspace data, daemon) is not included.
regeneration: Nx runs the tasks again and caches their outputs.

title: .NET central build output (artifacts/bin, obj)
description: Compiled libraries and intermediate files of a .NET solution that uses the central artifacts layout (UseArtifactsOutput). Published apps and packages in artifacts/publish and artifacts/package are not included.

title: .NET test results (TestResults)
description: Results, coverage reports and diagnostic dumps written by dotnet test. They can be the only record of an earlier failure.
regeneration: Run the tests again; the results of earlier runs cannot be recreated.
